messages:
Sam: Quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A — a few people asked for concrete windows on API, Console, and Optimize. I'll collect answers here so we have a single thread.
Jia: tl;dr: API feature set (rate limits + streaming SLA) -> beta in 6w, GA in 12w if no regressions. Console new dashboards -> soft-launch in 8w, GA in 16w. Optimize recommendations -> internal beta in 4w, public beta 10w.
Leah: can you clarify what "beta" means for Console? soft-launch vs. beta confused some PMs.
Jia: sure — soft-launch = limited customers + feature flag in Console. beta = public opt-in and docs + SDKs. GA = SLA + removed feature flag.
Mike: any dependency on Dedicated/Private timelines? some customers need Optimize before they commit to Dedicated.
Jia: Optimize recommendations rely on the runtime telemetry export from Dedicated v2 (small API change). We're targeting the telemetry endpoint bump in Dedicated 3w. if that slips, Optimize public beta shifts by same delta.
Ana: SDK releases? front-end and JS SDKs need hooks for streaming + structured output. engineers asking for exact version pins.
Jia: JS SDK v2.1 will include streaming hooks and structured-output helpers; releasing with Console soft-launch (8w). Python SDK mirrors will follow within 1w.
Leah: who owns the docs + example apps? need owner to coordinate launch checklist.
Sam: assign to Ana for SDK docs, Leah for Console UX docs, Mike for Optimize eval-kit. I'll add them to the launch checklist.
Ana: noted. I'll create a repo with canonical examples (streams, function-calls, structured-output) and link it in the Console docs. ETA: 6w for initial examples.
Mike: for Optimize eval-kit — will it include cost/perf baselines and prompt sets? customers will want reproducible numbers.
Mike: also can we get a small matrix of recommended quantization + batch settings per model? Ops wants guidance.
Jia: yes to both. baseline scripts + prompt sets included in eval-kit. quantization recommendations will be a separate doc in Optimize (initially community models + Redwood-verified profiles).
deploy-bot: Deployed branch: release/console-dashboard -> staging @ 1802345700 :rocket:
Leah: any blockers flagged during the Q&A that we should surface to execs? I heard concerns about rollback strategy for Console GA.
Sam: good point. rollback plan: automatic feature-flag cutover + fallback to previous Console via A/B toggle. Net-new DB migrations will be behind feature flag for first 2 weeks.
Ana: can we get a short runbook for rollback steps? I'll link it in the examples repo.
Jia: next steps: I'll post a short timeline doc with owners and exact dates by EOD tomorrow. If any owner thinks the windows are unrealistic, reply here with constraints.
Leah: thanks — I'll circulate to PM guild and SRE for review.
Sam: appreciate it. small ask — ping product@redwood if you want to be in the soft-launch cohort.
Ana: adding an item: telemetry and privacy checklist for Optimize must be signed off by security before public beta.
Jia: noted; security sign-off in 9w target.
Mike: putting this in my calendar. can someone mark action items?
Leah: action items: Ana -> examples repo + SDK docs, Mike -> Optimize eval-kit, Jia -> timeline doc + quant recommendation draft, Sam -> exec rollback sign-off.
Sam: perfect. closing loop — will follow up in #product-updates when timeline doc is live. :thumbsup:
